specs.title: curve supports two bend drags and one undoable commit
polygon click corners and Enter produces a filled shape
100 actual pointer strokes never create visible layers
free-form selection has a real polygon mask and leaves outside pixels
percentage resize, invalid dimensions, Cancel and nearest neighbour work
selection options switch Color 2 transparency and preserve true alpha
AI on a raster layer replaces alpha rather than covering the old background
bundled thumbnails decode and palette ends in exact signature blue
drawing commits an opaque deselected asset onto its existing layer
pasted transparency key survives resize after Color 2 changes
mixed selection keeps each transparency key unless the checkbox is explicitly changed
native layer drag and drop immediately refreshes the sidebar and supports undo
right-click eraser on a transparent layer preserves partial alpha and leaves empty pixels empty
a missing application script shows a usable startup error instead of a white screen
pencil, Color 1 / Color 2, cursor and Ctrl+Numpad widths
brush widths and 100 strokes stay on the active raster layer with undo/redo
eraser on background uses Color 2, fill and eyedropper work
all brush variants produce strokes, shapes honor outline and fill
canvas boundary handles resize the canvas, not pixels, and undo
asset insertion at exact (0,0), original dimensions at every zoom and alpha
object corner and edge resizing, aspect lock, no cumulative source degradation
free rotation handle, numerical rotation, flips and undo
rectangular and free selections can move, Color 2 transparency works
clipboard copy/paste preserves dimensions and transforms remain editable
layers select, hide, lock, duplicate, reorder and merge
multi-layer grouping transforms objects together and ungroups
asset removal, categories, search, favorite, list and thumbnail controls work
independent panel collapse expands workspace and persists across launch
project save/reopen preserves source, groups, layers, text and exact pixels
exports PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP and browser Quick Save produce real images
shortcut edits preserve reserved controls and work without intercepting text fields
zoom changes viewport scaling only, rulers and scrolling follow canvas
tool cursors change across drawing, text, selection, eyedropper and handles
text creates editable object, rasterizes from original and undoes
Lanczos worker rasterizes object and preserves undoable original
offline CPU AI actually removes background and keeps alpha
zoom buttons, wheel and slider use only fixed Paint levels and pixelated image display
screen overlay keeps seven-pixel handles at 100% and 400%, without huge allocations
brush main button selects default or last brush and only its arrow opens the menu
selection buttons are equal, transparency has a number shortcut and Crop is absent from mappings
editable shapes transform, change stroke width/fill and retain exact undo state
Paint selections move immediately, click outside commits, and Enter returns the originating tool
persistent selection mode keeps floating content after clicking outside
Shift arrow moves one pixel and stamps a trail with undo; Shift drag leaves a continuous trail
row bin and Delete remove layers instantly, including clearing the last layer, with undo
canvas ribbon dimensions extend boundaries without scaling and undo does not edit the filename
large paste expands by default as one undo action and the setting preserves canvas bounds
inline textbox uses contextual formatting, rounded bubble padding/spacing and grows while typing
text remains editable after outside click and resizing; project reopen retains all formatting
asset width and folder splitters resize and persist, categories can be removed
external copy preserves secondary-color pixels as opaque colors instead of black
refinement is nonmodal, threshold can restore details and softness changes pixels
malformed saved shortcut preferences recover to defaults without a blank startup
